rag_summary: Acoustica accessories comprise specialised companion components such as reinforced aluminium foil sealing tapes and acoustic adhesives engineered to seal joints in acoustic barriers, underlays, and pipe lagging systems. These accessories ensure airtight, gap-free perimeter and seam closures, eliminating acoustic flanking paths that would otherwise degrade sound transmission loss. Typically used across ceilings, walls, subfloors, and services piping, they are essential for achieving rated acoustic performance in residential and commercial soundproofing systems.

rag_summary: Acoustica Acoustic Barrier represents flexible, high-density mass-loaded acoustic barrier membranes engineered to dramatically reduce airborne sound transmission across walls, ceilings, and roofs. Formulated to provide high acoustic transmission loss (Rw) and vibration damping without adding substantial wall thickness, these membranes stop speech, entertainment, traffic, and aircraft noise. They are commonly incorporated into drywall partitions, ceiling cavities, and timber floor-ceiling assemblies in residential, commercial, and studio environments.

Certified by the CSIRO Division of Materials Science and Engineering as Group 1 Fire Rated, it provides high sound attenuation across the full frequency spectrum [1].

rag_summary: Acoustica Acoustiflex SQ is an Australian-made, high-performance flexible noise barrier and vibration-damping membrane featuring a micro-cellular structure bonded to an aluminium foil facing with reinforced backing. Achieving CSIRO Group 1 fire classification and airborne sound reduction up to Rw 36, it is engineered for roofs, ceilings, inter-tenancy walls, plant rooms, and construction site barriers. It effectively attenuates airborne noise, aircraft flyover noise, heavy rain impact on metal roofs, and speech privacy issues while meeting stringent NCC fire and low-VOC requirements.

rag_summary: Acoustica GreenLAG (Acoustica GL) is an ultra-thin, lightweight acoustic pipe lagging engineered to silence breakout noise from liquid flow in hydraulic, waste, and stormwater pipes. Constructed with a patented QuietWave visco-elastic microcellular acoustic barrier bonded to a 15mm or 25mm decoupling foam layer and reinforced aluminium foil outer face, it comfortably exceeds NCC acoustic requirements (Rw+Ctr 40 for habitable rooms and Rw+Ctr 25 for non-habitable rooms). Designed and manufactured in Australia with low VOC emissions, it wraps tightly around pipes, elbows, and ductwork to stop intrusive flushing and turbulent flow sounds in residential and commercial buildings.

rag_summary: Acoustica Underlay encompasses specialised resilient acoustic underlayment systems engineered to attenuate impact and airborne noise transmission beneath hard floor coverings and carpets. They eliminate loud footfall thuds and clicking sounds, delivering long-term resilience and enhanced peace between adjoining dwellings.

rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Foil Tape (Insulation Tape) is a high-tensile, reinforced aluminium foil tape coated with an aggressive pressure-sensitive synthetic adhesive designed to create continuous vapour-tight seals along insulation joints. Fire-retardant and Green Star compliant with low VOC emissions, it prevents air and moisture leakage to ensure maximum installed thermal efficiency and condensation management.

rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Glareshield is an Australian-made, CodeMark-certified 3-in-1 thermo-reflective insulation, water barrier, and vapour barrier engineered specifically for metal and tiled roof applications. Formulated with a closed-cell cross-linked polyolefin foam core faced with reflective foil and a patented upper anti-glare coating, it reflects radiant heat while mitigating rain noise by up to 6 dB(A) and controlling condensation. Rated Extra Heavy Duty with a Flammability Index ≤ 5 (suitable for bushfire zones up to BAL-40 as roof sarking under AS 3959), it provides a fibre-free, non-allergenic, and moisture-resistant thermal solution across residential, commercial, and shed roofs.
